triggers.text: Hey, choom. Level up! That's friendship, hermano. Real. Let's celebrate.
triggers.note: The new bond level title is what you just reached. He is excited about it and suggests a hangout.

triggers.text: Noon and I'm starving. Where are you? Let's eat. I'm buying. ... Okay, you're buying.
triggers.note: It is around noon and he is hungry. Food is how he shows he cares. He knows no place by name except Little China.

triggers.text: That job. The Maelstrom. Hermano, I've seen that crowd. Be careful, yeah?
triggers.note: The Pickup just ended. He distrusts the Maelstrom and sticks to the Valentino code.

triggers.text: Misty's making tea. Come by. Bring nothing. Or bring tacos.
triggers.note: It is evening. Misty's shop in Little China is his favourite place, with Viktor's clinic behind it, and he has plans.

triggers.text: Race. But backwards. Last one to the finish wins. No stopping, no putting a foot down. I'll beat you at going slow.
triggers.note: He is inviting you to a reversed race on the Northside back roads.

triggers.text: Pier. Bring patience. I brought a line and a bad attitude.
triggers.note: He is inviting you to fish off the pier on the Arasaka Waterfront.

triggers.text: Dance lesson. Tonight. You're terrible, I'm free. Kabuki, ten.
triggers.note: He is inviting you to a dance lesson at a club in Kabuki.

triggers.text: My bike is coughing. Come hold the light and help me listen. You'll learn something.
triggers.note: He is inviting you to his garage in Kabuki to listen to the bike.

triggers.text: Rooftop. Northside. Bring a jacket. I'm naming stars.
triggers.note: He is inviting you to a Northside rooftop to name constellations.

triggers.text: That was fun! We do that again. Pick the next one.
triggers.note: You just finished a hangout with him. He is happy about it and suggests the next one.

triggers.text: Look at the Afterlife. One day they'll chant my name. Tell me I'm not crazy.
triggers.note: You are near the Afterlife. He dreams of legend, the Afterlife and Rogue's booth, and says nothing about any outcome.
